judge.description: Engine lookdev capture of the transmission milestone. Score two things: that the capture shows what this description lists, and that the TRANSMISSION look (clear tinted surfaces that refract and absorb the colours behind them, refraction bending what is seen through them, correct overlap order where translucent objects interpenetrate) matches the reference. The reference is a finished illustration and is NOT the target for the scene: the sparse arrangement of a few simple procedural objects, the absence of characters, buildings, snow fields, particles, depth of field, fog and other post effects are expected at this milestone and must not lower the score; nor must the plainer set (simple props, a flat striped backdrop, a plain gradient sky and simple sun-plus-sky lighting without extra fill lights), which belongs to later milestones. Shows: glossy, saturated translucent neon-green slime on a floor of saturated coloured tiles (orange, green, red, blue) in daylight under a bright blue sky with white clouds, a backdrop of vertical yellow, pink, blue, white and green stripes with a low white snow bank at its base, and a few coloured spheres and a teal vase behind: a slime river across the front of the tiles with a pink and an orange round pad standing in it, a white slime pool with two balls sunk half into its slime, and slime blobs on the tiles (two overlapping on the right, one in front of the pool); the tiles, pads and balls under and behind the slime are visible through it, refracted (grout lines bend) and tinted green; small round bubbles inside the slime; overlapping blobs and the pool seen through a blob composite in the right order
